Proposition
Source: topping:page-0112, topping:page-0113 ↗ topping-ch9-parallel-function ↗ topping-ch9-convex-parallel-function 1. ch9:5.4\group curvature-pinching

Suppose $E(t)\in \Gamma (W)$ satisfies \[ \frac{\partial E}{\partial t}-\Delta _AE=\Upsilon (E). \] For a parallel convex function $\Psi $, \[ \left(\frac{\partial }{\partial t}-\Delta _{\mathcal M}\right)(\Psi \circ E) \le d\Psi (E)\! \left(\Upsilon (E)\right). \]
